items.guidance: Check whether immich-server and immich-machine-learning are built from different Dockerfiles or images in docker/docker-compose.prod.yml; the detected start command (python -m immich_ml) and machine-learning/Dockerfile suggest the analysed image is the ML service, not the Node/Express server. If they come from separate builds, report that the deployment needs two application images, and state which one Deployz would run.

Check whether the bullmq consumers and worker_threads usage live in the Node server code rather than the Python machine-learning image that is the detected start target, and report which image and entry point start them. If the server code starts the job processing itself, report the file and the command or setting involved. Also report that bullmq needs Redis, which maps to the provided Valkey through REDIS_URL or the names the app reads.

Check machine-learning/Dockerfile for a build argument or target that selects a CPU variant, and check the compose file for an image tag or setting that selects a device. Report the exact argument or tag name and the value that gives a CPU-only build. If no CPU variant exists, report the GPU-specific base image or dependency lines as evidence.
